preamble: Chapter rule 1: Any good of chapter 36 that is a product of a chemical reaction, as defined in subdivision (n)(v) of this note, shall be considered to be an originating good if the chemical reaction occurred in the territory of Singapore or of the United States.

rules.text: A change to headings 3601 through 3606 from any other heading, including another heading within that group.

warning: Not updated for Pres.Proc. 8771, effective Feb. 3, 2012.
